title: lieberkuhna piloselloides
intro: Lieberkuhna piloselloides, commonly known as German tansy, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lieberkuhna piloselloides include its ability to modulate the nervous system, promote relaxation, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as pilosellin and lactucarium, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
